p1: Precise-object-edit for a Spine puppet underpaint. Edit the provided fox master. REMOVE BOTH EYES AND BOTH EYELINERS ONLY, replace their areas seamlessly with the same uninterrupted plain ivory facial fur as the forehead. Keep the complete fox's silhouette, exact pose, proportions, muzzle, nose, mouth, ears, legs, paws, tail, all outlines, colors, shading, framing and transparent background IDENTICAL to the input. Do not move, resize, rotate, redesign or redraw any other part. This output is the blank face layer underneath separately extracted eye layers. No eyebrows, no eyelids, no sockets, no new marks: just smooth plain facial fur where the two eyes used to be. Genuine transparent background, preserve the original canvas size and subject position.
